Funds.heading: Where your gift goes
Funds.lead: Choose what your gift pays for, or let our members put it where it's needed most.

general.name: Where it's needed most
general.description: Lets our members put your gift toward whichever project needs it next.

morale.name: Morale and events
morale.description: Pays for the cookouts, game nights and trips that bring Airmen together, especially those new to the base.

development.name: Professional growth
development.description: Helps junior Airmen build leadership skills through workshops, mentoring, study groups and professional development days.

community.name: Community projects
community.description: Buys the paint, tools and supplies Airmen use to improve the base and the local community.

About.title: About {orgName}
About.lead: An Airman-tier organization, run by Airmen for Airmen in the ranks E-⁠1 to E-⁠4.
About.missionBody1: Junior enlisted Airmen are the largest part of the force, and often the newest to the base: far from home, early in their careers, still finding their people.
About.missionBody2: {orgName} gives them a place to improve morale and welfare, grow as leaders, and make a difference on base and in the community. Airmen in the tier plan and run all of it.

choice.title: You choose where it goes
choice.body: Every gift goes to the fund you pick, or to wherever the need is greatest if you leave that to us.

open.title: We show our work
open.body: We'll publish what we raise and how it's spent once our first annual report is ready.

airmen.title: Run by Airmen
airmen.body: Members in the E-⁠1 to E-⁠4 tier choose the projects, plan them and carry them out. Nobody is paid to run {orgName}.

About.teamLead: Officers elected by the members. We'll introduce them here soon.
About.independenceBody1: {orgName} is a private organization. It is not part of the Department of Defense or any of its components and has no governmental status.
About.independenceBody2: Our members serve in the Air Force, but {orgName} speaks only for itself, and gifts to it are not gifts to the Air Force.
About.ctaHeading: Back the Airmen who make it happen
About.ctaBody: Give once or monthly, or lend a hand on a project.

morale.title: Morale
morale.body: Events, activities and projects that build friendships and strengthen unit cohesion.

welfare.title: Welfare
welfare.body: A forum where Airmen raise concerns about daily life and work together on solutions.

growth.title: Professional growth
growth.body: Chances to lead, take on responsibility and learn from mentors early in a career.

community.title: Community
community.body: Volunteering on base and local projects, from refurbishing facilities to helping neighbors.

Programs.title: Programs
Programs.lead: Three funds, each paying for a different part of our mission. Here's what each one covers and how a project comes together.

idea.title: An Airman brings an idea
idea.body: At a meeting, or by talking to any officer. Every member can suggest something.

plan.title: Members plan it together
plan.body: We vote on it, work out a budget and choose who leads it.

run.title: Airmen make it happen
run.body: Your gifts pay for supplies and tickets. Members do the work and report back.

general.item1: Whichever project is short this month
general.item2: Ideas that don't fit neatly into one fund
general.item3: New needs members raise during the year

morale.item1: Dorm cookouts, game nights and holiday meals
morale.item2: Group trips and tickets to local events
morale.item3: Welcome events for Airmen new to the base

development.item1: Leadership workshops and professional development days
development.item2: Study materials for courses and promotion testing
development.item3: Mentoring sessions with senior enlisted leaders

community.item1: Paint, furniture and tools for refurbishing base facilities
community.item3: Donation drives for the local community

Programs.joinHeading: Are you an Airman, E-⁠1 to E-⁠4?
Programs.joinBody: You're already part of the tier. Come to a meeting, bring an idea, or tell us what would make life on base better.

Stories.title: Stories
Stories.lead: What your support makes possible, told by the Airmen who were there.
Stories.sampleNotice: This is a sample story written to show how this page will look. Real stories, shared with permission, will replace it.

dorm-cookout.name: Jaylen
dorm-cookout.title: The cookout that made the dorms feel like home
dorm-cookout.summary: Three months into his first assignment, Jaylen hadn't met anyone outside his shop. A dorm cookout paid for by the morale fund changed that.
dorm-cookout.quote: I knew the people I worked with. After that night, I knew my neighbors.

study-hall.name: Keisha
study-hall.title: A study group and a room full of mentors
study-hall.summary: Keisha started a weekly study group for Airmen preparing for promotion testing. The professional growth fund paid for the books, and senior NCOs came to help.
study-hall.quote: Leading the group taught me as much as the books did.

day-room-rebuild.name: Marcus
day-room-rebuild.title: Rebuilding the dorm day room
day-room-rebuild.summary: Twenty Airmen spent two weekends turning a tired dorm day room into a space people actually use. The community fund bought the paint and furniture.
day-room-rebuild.quote: We walk past that room every day. Now it's ours, because we built it.

WaysIn.heading: Find your way in

donors.title: Give once or every month
donors.body: Monthly gifts give us steady support we can plan around. One-time gifts go to work right away.
donors.item1: Pick an amount and how often you'd like to give.
donors.item2: Pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

companies.title: Partner with us
companies.body: Local businesses can sponsor an event, donate supplies, or get their team involved.
companies.item1: Sponsor an event or a project.

volunteers.title: Give your time
volunteers.body: From cookouts to building projects, there's a way to help that fits your schedule.
volunteers.item2: Lend a skill, like carpentry, design or mentoring.
volunteers.item3: Spread the word in your unit or community.

WaysIn.lead: Whether you want to give, you're in the Airman tier, or you want to help, start here.

airmen.title: Get involved
airmen.body: If you're in the Airman tier, you're already one of us. Bring an idea or join a project.
airmen.item1: Send us a message or come to a meeting.
airmen.item2: Tell us what you'd like to do or change.
airmen.item3: Join a project, or lead one.

VolunteerBand.title: Can't give right now? Give your time.
VolunteerBand.body: Airmen run everything we do. Tell us what you're good at and we'll find a fit.
